offering_description.value: Operates mountain resorts and ski areas, selling season passes, lift tickets, lodging, lessons and dining to skiers, snowboarders and summer visitors. It earns money from passes, daily tickets and on-mountain and resort services.

primary_products.value: season passes; lift tickets; retail merchandise; food and beverage

primary_services.value: ski and snowboard lessons; lodging; equipment rental; golf; summer mountain activities

customer_segment.value: B2C: skiers, snowboarders and summer visitors, including season pass holders

end_markets.value: leisure travel and hospitality; winter sports; outdoor recreation

revenue_model.value: subscription: season pass sales for access to resort mountains; transaction or usage fees: daily lift tickets; service fees: lodging, ski school, rentals and dining; product sales: retail merchandise and food and beverage
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs ski mountains, lifts and resort facilities, selling passes and tickets to guests; service provider: takes in guest bookings and sells lessons, lodging and dining to visitors

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, Switzerland and Australia mountain resorts

specialization.value: related lines: mountain resort operations, season passes, lodging, ski school, rentals and dining serving the same guests

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: season passes and tickets sold directly to guests; own locations: resort ticket windows, lodging front desks and on-mountain shops; online: website and app sales of passes, tickets and lodging

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental and land-use permits for public forest land, plus safety, liability and data privacy rules

notes: The current scope of international resort holdings is uncertain.
